statement.notes: MAPPING NOTES: 1) 'investment_in_securities' calculated as sum of 'Short-term investments', 'Equity securities and other investments' (current and non-current), and 'Equity method investments'. 2) 'accounts_receivable' and 'inventory' not separately reported; bundled in 'Prepayments, receivables and other assets'. 3) 'advance_payments_for_purchases' not separately identified. 4) 'total_non_current_liabilities' calculated as total liabilities minus total current liabilities. 5) 'short_term_debt' calculated as sum of 'Short-term bank borrowings' and 'Short-term unsecured senior notes'. 6) 'long_term_debt' calculated as sum of 'Long-term bank borrowings', 'Long-term unsecured senior notes', and 'Long-term convertible unsecured senior notes'. 7) 'accounts_payable_and_or_other_liabilities' calculated as sum of 'Accrued expenses, accounts payable and other liabilities' and 'Other liabilities' (non-current). 8) 'advance_payments_from_sales' calculated as sum of 'Deferred revenue and customer advances' (current) and 'Deferred revenue (non-current)'. 9) 'total_equity' taken directly from statement line 'Total equity' (includes non-controlling interests).
